name: hair by delina- ST. PETE
address_raw: 511 DR MARTIN LUTHER KING JR STREET N, SAINT PETERSBURG, FL 33713
about:
Hi, I’m Delina — and hair has truly been my passion for as long as I can remember. I’ve been behind the chair for over 11 years, and what I love most about this industry is helping women feel confident, beautiful, and like the best version of themselves when they leave my chair.

I’m originally from Michigan, but now call Florida home. I’m a brunette specialist and love creating rich, dimensional color, seamless blends, voluminous blowouts, layered cuts, and luxury extensions that still feel natural and effortless. My style is all about soft, lived-in beauty that grows out beautifully and fits your everyday life.

Beyond the hair itself, I care deeply about the experience my clients have with me. I’ve built my business on honesty, trust, good energy, and making people feel comfortable the moment they sit down. I know how personal hair can be, and I never take for granted the trust my clients place in me.

Outside of the salon, I’m a family person at heart, a huge Detroit Lions fan, and someone who’s always chasing sunshine, good food, and beautiful experiences. Whether you’re coming in for a subtle refresh or a full transformation, my goal is always the same — for you to leave feeling confident, feminine, and completely yourself. ✨
